hero.title: Deliver Efficient Reach with Sell-Side AI Decisioning
hero.subtitle: Maximize cost-efficient audience delivery with AI-curated PMPs that surface underexposed, high-quality impressions.

impact.title: Lower CPMs. Higher Quality. Same Target Audience.
impact.description: Advertisers set the audience. Your DSP handles the targeting. But not all inventory is created equal - some impressions cost more, compete more, and deliver less. Our AI decisioning engine operates on the sell side, surfacing high-quality, underutilized impressions that your DSP can match to your target segments - at lower CPMs and less frequency waste. This means:

descParts.text: We analyze contextual, auction, and supply data (e.g., floor price, cleared CPM, site, geo, device, attention metrics) to
score every impression for cost-efficiency and quality.
real-time PMP of impressions likely to match your audience at a lower cost.
We deliver a deal ID for activation in your DSP.
We retrain models daily using delivery, pacing, and pricing signals to
improve performance and avoid oversaturated supply.

why.description: While DSPs play a key role in media performance, they often operate without direct access to impression-level survey, attention, and contextual signals. inPowered AI complements these platforms by optimizing from the source, on the sell side, where data is freshest and decisions can drive real impact.
